what: Weighted silhouette IoU of the Hawk Dash against its reference sheets (tools/vehicles/fit: side 0.4, top 0.3, front 0.15, rear 0.15). before = the br-bwju.3 bake: LOD0 and LOD2 from its committed score.json (before-br-bwju.3/); LOD1 was never scored then, so its number comes from the same evaluator ported to the CPU (it agreed with the browser within 0.001 on LOD0 and LOD2). after = reference-lod<N>/score.json, commit 09a3e725, Playwright Chromium on eris. tris are the bake's (parts only; the interior blocks, 84 triangles drawn only when exposed, are left out; the fit page's stats include them).
note: The weighted score is flat (LOD0 -0.0005, LOD1 +0.0005, LOD2 -0.005): the old body already fitted the outline well, and this rebuild was about the details inside it. Side and rear rise at every LOD; front falls (LOD0 0.948 -> 0.934) because the nose now has the sheet's flat fascia and narrower plan, which the evaluator's 8-degree front camera reads as a taller, narrower front. By eye the front is much closer to the sheet (ladder-lod0.png), so the by-eye pass wins there (the Lion President's front-camera lesson).
